intentional_differences.purpose: Versioned cross-platform configure and build presets for the Phase 1 OpenMW baseline test path.
Machine-readable OpenMW baseline, cutover, dependency-input, and intentional-difference record.
Living vNext phase, gate, status, and verification tracker.
Reference-only inventory of archived TES3MP gameplay behavior.
Documented local configure, build, test, provisioning, and evidence procedure for the pinned baseline.
Recorded pre-cutover repository and archive provenance.
Accepted vNext product direction and architecture boundaries.
Owner-approved platform, CI, toolchain, and dependency policy.
Cross-platform local baseline configure, build, upstream-test, and evidence runner.
Unit tests for local baseline runner validation and dependency-lock handling.
Failure-case tests for the machine-checkable provenance contract.
Cross-platform verifier that fails on unrecorded tree or dependency-input drift.
Pinned Windows local-baseline dependency manifest, archive, Qt, and acquisition-tool identities.

dependency_inputs.resolution: OpenMW 0.51 CMake declarations pin fetched source tags or commits and integrity hashes; the vNext presets and runner define the shared local test build while system package alternatives remain platform-selected.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: Fetched projects supply their own license files; system-package and bundle license inventories must be retained with the resolved environment artifacts in Slices 1.4-1.7.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.4 captures local resolved-tool and dependency evidence; Slices 1.5-1.7 retain the corresponding CI environment and license artifacts for every supported platform.

dependency_inputs.resolution: The hashed installer records the exact package names and repository declarations inherited from OpenMW 0.51; package versions are runner-resolved and the inherited workflow still uses ubuntu-latest.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: Ubuntu package metadata and /usr/share/doc package copyright files are the authoritative resolved license evidence and must be archived by the Linux baseline job.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.5 replaces the floating runner label per ADR-0002 and archives exact resolved package and license metadata.

dependency_inputs.resolution: The dependency bundle name pins VCPKG_TAG 2026-02-24 and its downloaded manifest supplies an archive hash; the inherited manifest URL, Homebrew installer, and Homebrew packages remain floating inputs.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: The dependency bundle and Homebrew package metadata supply resolved licenses; their exact inventory must be archived by the macOS baseline jobs.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.7 makes the macOS dependency retrieval reproducible, captures the downloaded manifest and hash, and archives package/license inventories for both architectures.

dependency_inputs.resolution: The local dependency lock pins the OpenMW dependency repository commit and manifest SHA-256, bundle URL and SHA-512, Qt 6.6.3 target, and aqtinstall v3.1.15 SHA-256; the inherited CI workflow remains on main until Slice 1.6.
dependency_inputs.license_evidence: The local runner inventories the bundle's vcpkg package lists and retained copyright files and records the exact Qt version; Slice 1.6 must retain the same resolved license evidence as a Windows CI artifact.
dependency_inputs.phase1_follow_up: Slice 1.6 integrates the commit-pinned acquisition path into Windows CI and archives its exact environment, package, manifest, and license inventories.
